title: Prefer keeping a box relatively small in comparison with its containing view

statement.en: Favor keeping a box relatively small in comparison with its containing view when the documented conditions apply.
statement.ja: 該当条件ではkeeping a box relatively small in comparison with its containing viewを優先する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Boxes experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
